questions.question: How quickly should INSTANT results appear?
questions.notes: Conservative. Waits longer before searching. Reduces API calls.

questions.question: If EVOLVING phase fails/times out?
questions.notes: Keep results + small indicator 'AI unavailable'. User knows ranking is basic.

questions.question: Click outside or ESC behavior?
questions.notes: Click outside or ESC closes dropdown. Clears search. Standard behavior.

questions.question: When user clicks a result?
questions.notes: Navigate to note. Sidebar stays open showing Note Vitals for new note.

analysis: Progressive Search UX: 300ms debounce (conservative), graceful AI fallback with subtle warning, standard dismiss behavior, sidebar persists on navigation.
